subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google’s Vertex AI rebrand?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but Google’s current wording differs from the issue’s exact request and the stable provider id must not be renamed casually.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform copy
options.body: Update only labels and docs to Google’s current rebrand wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt shorter UI copy but document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider and Vertex API/ADC setup.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current copy until maintainers decide the newer Google branding is clearer for OpenClaw users.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform copy
recommendation.body: Update only labels and docs to Google’s current rebrand wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google provider onboarding/manifest work makes this the strongest inspected routing signal for the copy/product decision.
